scope: Fresh strength-interpolation assay with calibrated response curves on unchanged 64-us tissue dynamics; numerical qualification and decoding outcomes remain separate.
purpose: Test whether balanced calibration and explicit strength variation address the diagnosed centroid confound, without changing cues, selecting features or inspecting fresh evaluation responses before registration.

reader.calibration: All four location/timing combinations at three ordered strengths, fitted separately in each physical arm; the midpoint provides two fixed interpolation segments. Single-task duplicates are excluded from fitting and scoring.
reader.features: The unchanged 21 area-weighted membrane-voltage features at 40, 48 and 64 us; both labels use this one shared observation. No per-feature scaling or feature selection.
reader.prediction: Project each observed vector onto each adjacent calibration segment with its coordinate clipped to [0,1]. For each task, take the minimum distance among curves with label 0 and label 1. Score=(distance_0-distance_1)/2; positive predicts 1, otherwise 0. Prediction accepts features only: no evaluation strength, labels, IDs or paired counterpart.
reader.margin: Resolved only when abs(score) exceeds the declared margin. Half the distance gap is in feature units and is 1-Lipschitz for fixed curves; it is not a biological noise model or a guarantee of correct generalization. Distances and inferred segment coordinates are retained.
reader.shuffles: Permute whole curve label pairs with the fixed seeds after fitting vertices. This preserves each physical response curve and the balanced label set. Duplicate permutations and the identity are retained; no significance claim.

generalization: Interpolation to four fresh strengths, with all location/timing combinations represented in calibration. This does not retest generalization to an unseen combination or independent biological preparations.
scientific_target: Report whether every fresh joint-arm case has both labels correct and resolved at the primary 2-nV margin. Also report all failures, abstentions, comparator modes and controls. This target is an outcome, never an engineering acceptance gate.
scope_exclusions: No changes to the physical model, geometry, cue timing, observation support, 64-us horizon, numerical tolerances or previous results.
No fresh evaluation simulation or response inspection during development. Synthetic known-answer reader tests and nonintegrating resource planning precede frozen-source launch.
No adaptive template density, fitted feature scaling, hyperparameter search, evaluation-strength input, evaluation-label fitting or feedback to physics.
The original assay's failed combination holdout remains unchanged. The present all-combinations calibration answers a different, explicitly declared question.
A shared external decoder yields two labels; this is not two causal biological consumers or evidence of biological polycomputing, memory, reconstruction or heredity.
The timing-refinement result supports the chosen integration step on the prior panel, not a continuum certificate or fresh-strength convergence study.
Disconnected junctions leave other physical routes and direct source-cell observations. Separate per-arm calibration does not test decoder transfer.
Input history observes earlier controls rather than tissue. Final-time and 1-uV sensitivity modes are reported without selecting a preferred result.
Five arms have equal solver work. GPU-busy and measured SM-active with coverage are descriptive; no throughput or multi-GPU qualification.
